infer_predictions: SELECT movie.title AS movie_title, book_club.book_title AS book_title FROM culture_company JOIN movie ON culture_company.movie_id = movie.movie_id JOIN book_club ON culture_company.book_club_id = book_club.book_club_id WHERE culture_company.incorporated_in = 'China'
SELECT m.title AS movie_title, b.book_title FROM culture_company c JOIN movie m ON c.movie_id = m.movie_id JOIN book_club b ON c.book_club_id = b.book_club_id WHERE c.incorporated_in = 'China'

SELECT m.title AS movie_title, b.book_title FROM culture_company c INNER JOIN movie m ON c.movie_id = m.movie_id INNER JOIN book_club b ON c.book_club_id = b.book_club_id WHERE c.incorporated_in = 'China'

SELECT movie.title, book_club.book_title FROM culture_company, movie, book_club WHERE culture_company.movie_id = movie.movie_id AND culture_company.book_club_id = book_club.book_club_id AND culture_company.incorporated_in = 'China'

SELECT (SELECT title FROM movie WHERE movie_id = culture_company.movie_id) AS movie_title, (SELECT book_title FROM book_club WHERE book_club_id = culture_company.book_club_id) AS book_title FROM culture_company WHERE incorporated_in = 'China'

SELECT movie.title AS movie_title, book_club.book_title AS book_title FROM culture_company LEFT JOIN movie ON culture_company.movie_id = movie.movie_id LEFT JOIN book_club ON culture_company.book_club_id = book_club.book_club_id WHERE culture_company.incorporated_in = 'China'

SELECT DISTINCT movie.title AS movie_title, book_club.book_title FROM culture_company CROSS JOIN movie ON culture_company.movie_id = movie.movie_id CROSS JOIN book_club WHERE culture_company.book_club_id = book_club.book_club_id AND culture_company.incorporated_in = 'China'

WITH Movies AS (SELECT movie_id, title FROM movie), Books AS (SELECT book_club_id, book_title FROM book_club) SELECT mo.title AS movie_title, bo.book_title FROM culture_company cc JOIN Movies mo ON cc.movie_id = mo.movie_id JOIN Books bo ON cc.book_club_id = bo.book_club_id WHERE cc.incorporated_in = 'China'

SELECT movie.title AS 'Movie Title', book_club.book_title AS 'Book Title' FROM culture_company INNER JOIN movie ON culture_company.movie_id = movie.movie_id INNER JOIN book_club ON culture_company.book_club_id = book_club.book_club_id WHERE culture_company.incorporated_in = 'China'
